title: Blind Motor Calibration Drift
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=blindmotor:state
| stats avg(position_error_pct) as avg_position_error_pct, max(position_error_pct) as max_position_error_pct by blind
| where avg_position_error_pct>5 OR max_position_error_pct>10
| sort - avg_position_error_pct
description: Uses Smart blind motor telemetry telemetry to monitor how far blind positions drift from their intended state in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for motors that need recalibration before automations go wrong, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Smart blind motor telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Blind table of average and worst position error.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how far blind positions drift from their intended state so you can spot motors that need recalibration before automations go wrong before it becomes annoying.
